about.title: A Trusted Name in Events
about.p1: Earth Group MMC specializes in the management and organization of halls, trade fairs, congresses, conferences, and meeting venues. The company provides services in the professional organization, promotion, and management of events.
about.p2: In a short time, Earth Group MMC has become a recognized and trusted partner in the event sector. This success has been achieved through the dedication of a professional team, innovative approaches, and a client satisfaction-driven strategy.

pillar1.title: Professional Team
pillar1.desc: Every event is handled by a dedicated team of experienced specialists.

pillar2.title: Client-Centred Approach
pillar2.desc: We treat every client's requirements as our top priority, from first call to final wrap-up.

pillar3.title: Proven Track Record
pillar3.desc: Successfully co-organized Baku Marathon and international festivals across Azerbaijan.

page.title: Our Projects
page.subtitle: A selection of events successfully organized and managed across Azerbaijan.

marathon25.title: Baku Marathon 2025
marathon25.desc: Earth Group MMC served as co-organizer of the Baku Marathon 2025. The company played a key role in coordinating organizational activities, participant registration, volunteer management, and logistics services.

marathon26.title: Baku Marathon 2026
marathon26.desc: Earth Group MMC also participated as co-organizer of the 2026 Baku Marathon. The scope included establishing information centers, organizing security and technical support, sponsorship coordination, and public relations management.

bbq.title: Baku BBQ Festival 2025
bbq.desc: Earth Group MMC participated in organizing the BBQ Festival 2025. The company ensured food safety standards, prepared venues for participants, and coordinated cultural entertainment programs throughout the event.

wine.title: Wine Festival 2025
wine.desc: Earth Group MMC provided organizational support for the Wine Festival 2025. This included setting up exhibition pavilions, creating conditions for local and international producers, organizing master classes, and conducting tasting sessions for visitors.
